_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habits" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "repeat_forever" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("repeat_forever" IN (0, 1)), "repeat_days" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "type" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "scheduled_date" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habit_completions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "habit_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES habits (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "completion_date" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "streaks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "max_streak" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_updated" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "streak_history_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "streak_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES streaks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reached_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sleep_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "hours" REAL NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mood_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pomodoro_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "purpose" TEXT NULL, "cycles" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4, "focus_duration" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 25, "break_duration" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, "completed_cycles" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "todo_tasks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_comments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES todo_tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nutrition_goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "calories" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2000, "protein" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 120, "carbs" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 220, "fat" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 70, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "portion" TEXT NULL, "calories" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "protein" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "carbs" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "fat" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "meal" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foods" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "lower_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "portion" TEXT NULL, "calories" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "protein" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "carbs" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "fat" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_used_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "muscle_group" TEXT NULL, "video_url" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight" REAL NULL, "note" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "scheduled_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sets" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "rpe" INTEGER NULL, "comments" TEXT NULL, "feedback" TEXT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "recurrence_group_id" TEXT NULL, "repeat_days" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "repeat_forever" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("repeat_forever" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medications" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "dose" TEXT NULL, "schedule" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "active_from" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medication_intakes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "medication_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES medications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hydration_goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "millilitres" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2000, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "water_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "millilitres" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meditation_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL);
CREATE INDEX habit_completion_lookup ON habit_completions (habit_id, completion_date)
CREATE INDEX streak_history_lookup ON streak_history_entries (streak_id, reached_at)
CREATE INDEX task_project_lookup ON todo_tasks (project_id, status)
CREATE INDEX task_comment_lookup ON task_comments (task_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX food_entry_by_day ON food_entries (date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX food_by_name ON foods (lower_name)
CREATE INDEX exercise_set_by_day ON exercise_sets (date, exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX scheduled_exercise_by_day ON scheduled_exercises (scheduled_date)
CREATE INDEX scheduled_exercise_by_group ON scheduled_exercises (recurrence_group_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX intake_by_day ON medication_intakes (date, medication_id)
CREATE INDEX water_by_day ON water_entries (date)
CREATE INDEX meditation_by_day ON meditation_sessions (date)
